output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Rivian (RIVN) had 173,589,615 shares sold short, based on the latest reported settlement of October 30, 2026. That equals 18.41% of the reported float, or 11.89% of shares outstanding, and represents 5.88 days to cover. The October 30 position increased by 9,479,017 shares, or 5.78%, from the prior settlement.
caveats: Short interest is reported twice monthly and lags the settlement date; October 30, 2026 is the latest reported settlement available as of November 11, 2026.
The 18.41% figure uses a reported float, while 11.89% uses shares outstanding; these are different denominators, so they should not be treated as conflicting figures.
The next official cycle is expected to cover the November 13, 2026 settlement and be published around November 24, 2026.
